results.overview: ICE: three letters long unfamiliar to the general public. Established in 2003 in response to the 9/11 attacks, this federal agency—part of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS)—is responsible for enforcing immigration and customs laws.

results.title: Slide Strum Mute
results.overview: Woo-jin spirals into obsession and a cursed timeline after playing a broken guitar received from a mysterious stranger.

results.title: I Was a Teenage Sex Pistol
results.original_title: I Was a Teenage Sex Pistol
results.overview: Experience the Pistols' rise to global infamy with an honest, insightful account of a group of malcontents, determined to change the music business and to attack hypocrisy and stale conventions in society at large. Based off the novel written by Glen Matlock, one of the founding members of the Sex Pistols who co-wrote ten of twelve iconic songs on their only studio album, NEVER MIND THE BOLLOCKS. Glen describes in detail the mindset of the UK in the early 70's and divulges a mine of information; Steve's thievery, Wally Nightingale, the search for a singer, the exploding punk scene and a bleak backdrop providing a contrast to the excitement and energy of McLaren's shop. The public will now have a chance to hear the story, not just from a member of the band, but also from a man who had his contributions exceptionally downplayed.

results.title: Press Banca
results.overview: Dario, the invisible cleaner of a gym and struggling with self-esteem issues due to his obesity, desperately seeks to lose weight as quickly as possible. Misled by the promise of immediate results promoted by Kratos, an influencer, he follows all the bad advice from his channel—something that will have disastrous consequences.

results.title: Death and Life Madalena
results.overview: Madalena is a film producer having to deal with the recent death of her father, her 8-month pregnancy and the production of a B-sci-fi film where everything seems to go wrong.

results.title: Korpur
results.overview: In 1997, University Exam Controller Moushumi Sen disappeared amid a 50-crore scam. She fled to London, according to headlines, but a silenced police officer suspected a more sinister political conspiracy. Two decades later, journalist Anupam reopens the case, unearthing a labyrinth of institutional rot. Is she dead or hidden?

results.title: Children of the Sun
results.overview: Four friends from Berlin spend their summer in Greece trying to free themselves of all societal norms and conventions. They throw away their phones, open their relationships and begin to question all mental and physical limits in search of freedom. But just as their newfound utopia unfolds, forest fires erupt around their camp. The four friends realize that they might have to leave the country and above all, their youthful ideals behind.

results.title: M.R.P (Neekentha Naakentha)
results.overview: Three roommates borrow money from a dangerous lender to start a business. When their plan fails, they face serious consequences. Caught in a risky situation, they must use their wits to survive and fix their mistakes.

results.original_title: Bluey at the Cinema: Playdates with Friends
results.overview: A compilation of eight episodes from across the show’s three series, united around themes of play, friendship and family.

results.title: Rebound

results.title: Psych Siddhartha

However, just as Siddharth begins to rebuild his life and pursue a chance at love, his past resurfaces to threaten everything.
